name: Breach the Multiverse — "Then each creature you control becomes a Phyrexian in addition to its other types"
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). Two gaps: "Then" opened the sentence, and the lazy subject capture ran from the start of the spell. A sentence-opening "Then" is dropped, and a spell's last sentence "each X you control" is taken as the subject. Your Bears are a Phyrexian Bear; the opponent's are not.
